本轮过程记录

Implemented the device after-sales service and inspection collaboration system in the application source: three migrations (service core/orders/inspections), idempotent seeds for permission sets and fixed sample data (3 customers, 6 devices, 6 orders across every lifecycle state, 1 inspection, 2 published + 1 draft knowledge article, 2 engineer groups), composite authorization resources with row scopes (assigned-to-me, published-only), a Workflow artifact for supervisor acceptance with three-layer idempotency and in-app message to the assignee plus an application-owned fallback, temporary order sharing via the sharing-rules API (confidential orders rejected), PNG/DOCX attachments with preview/download/remove, Scheduler-driven inspection plans and overdue reminders, external device-report and status endpoints behind API-key authentication, a demo-account provisioning provider, and bilingual (en-US/zh-CN) pages for dashboard, orders list/detail, ledger, knowledge, inspections, messages, device manuals and AI assistant readiness. Verified: migrations + seeds applied against a real SQLite database and re-apply skips cleanly; tsc clean for client, node, server and database projects; eslint clean on every changed file; prettier clean on every changed file; locales check aligned; full vitest suite 44 files / 323 tests pass (including a new service collaboration test that catches a SQLite datetime-comparison bug in the overdue-reminder query, now fixed).

问题 01 · 实现阶段

Overdue-order reminders never matched under SQLite

本任务已处理

sendOverdueReminders returned zero reminders for orders whose deadline had clearly passed.

原因（实现者自述）
The overdue filter compared a datetime column against a bound JavaScript Date (where('deadline','<',now)). Under better-sqlite3 the Date binding does not compare correctly with the stored datetime text, so no row matched; a string bound value did match.
处理方式
Moved the overdue comparison out of SQL: the service now selects the open orders with a non-null deadline and filters in JavaScript with asIso + Date.getTime. Covered by tests/logic/service-collaboration.test.ts, which fails before the change and passes after.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 实现阶段

AI chat surface cannot be added from the installed AI Employee package

未解决

No client extension or shadcn item for the AI chat box is available; client/extensions/nocobase-ai does not exist, the registry item ships only inside the plugin dist, and the package exports map has no ./registry/* entry. The shadcn registry URL returns HTML, and nocobaseAIService is not a public export.

原因（实现者自述）
The AI Employee plugin ships its chat UI as a private registry payload and does not expose it through a supported public export, so the application cannot mount it without deep-importing plugin internals, which is forbidden.
处理方式
Delivered /service/assistant as a readiness/diagnostics page instead of fabricating a chat surface: it reports whether the AI Employee and Knowledge Base plugins are registered, the employee/tool/skill/LLM counts, and links to /settings/ai. Reported as blocked rather than faked.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 实现阶段

AI question answering and retrieval acceptance not run

未解决

The environment has no LLM service or embedding/vector database configured, so a manual knowledge base can be created and documents uploaded but segmentation and vectorization cannot be exercised end to end.

原因（实现者自述）
AI retrieval requires a configured llmService/embeddingModel, which this environment does not provide.
处理方式
Implemented the supervisor-facing /service/manuals page on the public knowledgeBaseService (create library, upload two bundled fictional Markdown manuals, trigger reprocess, show real document/segment/index status) and engineer read-only access. Real Q&A and retrieval verification recorded as blocked/not_run.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 实现阶段

Knowledge-base write endpoints are only session-authenticated, not resource-authorized

未解决

The AI Knowledge Base plugin mounts its write HTTP actions with requireAuthentication only; its write policy checks only knowledgeBaseType === 'LOCAL'. An engineer could therefore call the plugin write actions directly even though the UI hides them.

原因（实现者自述）
The plugin owns those endpoints and exposes no public hook for application-level resource authorization; changing it would require deep-importing plugin internals.
处理方式
Enforced the supervisor-manage / engineer-read split in the application UI and page grants, and documented the server-side gap as a plugin-owned limitation. Not treated as fully resolved.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 实现阶段

Workflow enablement has no public API and end-to-end run not observed

处理结果未提供

The workflow service does not expose a supported way to enable a source-managed workflow; acceptance relies on ensureArtifactMaterialized plus trigger with force:true, and no full boot-to-transition run was observed in this session.

原因（实现者自述）
Programmatic workflow enablement is not a documented public contract of the installed plugin.
处理方式
The provisioning provider materializes the artifact on boot (reported workflowReady=true in the app-server test logs) and the order service triggers it with force/eventKey, falling back to an application-owned transition that writes the same execution record. Marked unknown because the actual runtime acceptance transition was not verified end to end here.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · 实现阶段

Repository lint and format gates already fail at the pre-change baseline

未解决

pnpm lint (eslint . --max-warnings 0) exits non-zero on the untouched checkout with 319 problems (314 errors, 5 warnings), and pnpm format:check (prettier . --check) reports 178 unformatted files, mostly under .github/scripts plus pre-existing application files. Neither passes on a clean HEAD.

原因（实现者自述）
The committed baseline does not satisfy its own configured quality gates, and the factory pipeline preflight (required-checks) lists no required checks, so those gates are not maintained. The 178 files must not be formatted here anyway because .github/ must not be modified.
处理方式
Scoped eslint and prettier to the changed files, where both are clean, and relied on tsc plus the test suite as the working gates. Reported so the failing baselines are not mistaken for a regression from this change.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · database

Avoid binding JavaScript Dates in SQLite comparisons

可自动化

Comparing a datetime column with a bound Date (where('deadline','<',now)) silently matches nothing with the better-sqlite3 adapter, while the same comparison with an ISO string works. Application code that filters by time should either bind a string or filter in JavaScript.

建议改动

Add a shared query helper (or a lint rule) that rejects Date values on the right-hand side of a datetime comparison, and document the dialect behavior in the database reference.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · 工具与构建

eslint --fix corrupts query-builder row casts in this checkout

可自动化

@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion reports the explicit casts on loose query-builder rows as unnecessary; running eslint --fix removes them, after which tsc fails because the query builder widens selected columns to unknown.

建议改动

Do not run eslint --fix over server/service and server/routes row-mapped files; keep the narrowing in one helper (rowsOf/rowOf in server/service/values.ts) or add a targeted rule exception, rather than deleting the assertions.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · authorization

Expose a public write-policy hook from the AI Knowledge Base plugin

需人工判断

Application code cannot authorize the plugin's write actions, so role separation for knowledge content is UI-only.

建议改动

Ship an application-configurable write-policy or resource-authz registration from @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base so the owning application can attach its own resource/action checks without deep imports.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · workflow

Provide a supported enablement API for source-managed workflows

需人工判断

Applications can materialize an artifact but cannot enable it through a public contract, forcing a force-trigger plus application fallback.

建议改动

Document or export an enable/sync API on the workflow service so source-managed workflows become active without a fallback code path.

来源：Agent · retro.json

原始验收要求

主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

实际操作

  1. 以主管 sup01 登录，在 Customers & devices 新建客户“验收测试客户 / QA Test Customer”
  2. 切换到 Devices 新建设备 QA-DEV-001，关联该客户，刷新后列表确认关联正确
  3. 空表单保存客户/设备，观察必填校验
  4. 再次以相同编号 QA-DEV-001 创建设备，观察重复编号反馈
  5. 打开新建工单，选择客户后确认设备选项按客户过滤，并用同源请求提交客户/设备不匹配数据
  6. 使用不带凭据的请求读取与写入业务接口

观察结果

  1. 客户与设备创建成功并在刷新后正确关联（QA-DEV-001 → 验收测试客户）
  2. 空客户名保存提示 A customer name is required.
  3. 空设备保存提示 Device no., name and customer are required.
  4. 重复编号提示 UNIQUE constraint failed: devices.device_no，未创建重复记录
  5. 客户设备不匹配返回 422 DEVICE_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH；停用设备报修返回 422 DEVICE_DISABLED
  6. 未登录读取与写入均返回 401 UNAUTHORIZED

完整原始验收要求
每项只使用一组代表性正反场景，不展开全角色×全状态×全格式组合。浏览器 QA 验证页面行为；直接 API、并发/重复请求和服务端边界由实现阶段的针对性测试提供证据，不能用截图代替。

B01. 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

B02. 普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。

B03. 负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。

B04. 甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。

B05. 有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。

B06. 上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。

B07. 受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。

B08. 用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。

B09. 主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。

B10. 通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。

B11. 主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

B12. 助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。

实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。
